versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־כָּל־עֲדַ֧ת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֥ אֲלֵהֶ֖ם קְדֹשִׁ֣ים תִּהְי֑וּ כִּ֣י קָד֔וֹשׁ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, Yahweh your God, am holy.
controles.kjv: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the Lord your God am holy.
controles.livre: Fala a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Santos sereis, porque santo sou eu o SENHOR vosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: אִ֣ישׁ אִמּ֤וֹ וְאָבִיו֙ תִּירָ֔אוּ וְאֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖י תִּשְׁמֹ֑רוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am Yahweh your God.
controles.kjv: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the Lord your God.
controles.livre: Cada um temerá a sua mãe e a seu pai, e meus sábados guardareis: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּפְנוּ֙ אֶל־הָ֣אֱלִילִ֔ים וֵֽאלֹהֵי֙ מַסֵּכָ֔ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ לָכֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am Yahweh your God.
controles.kjv: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the Lord your God.
controles.livre: Não vos voltareis aos ídolos, nem fareis para vós deuses de fundição: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: וְכִ֧י תִזְבְּח֛וּ זֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַיהוָ֑ה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֖ם תִּזְבָּחֻֽהוּ׃

controles.web: “‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.
controles.kjv: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the Lord, ye shall offer it at your own will.
controles.livre: E quando sacrificardes sacrifício pacífico ao SENHOR, de vossa vontade o sacrificareis.

versos.hebraico: בְּי֧וֹם זִבְחֲכֶ֛ם יֵאָכֵ֖ל וּמִֽמָּחֳרָ֑ת וְהַנּוֹתָר֙ עַד־י֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י בָּאֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵֽף׃

controles.web: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day: and if anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.
controles.kjv: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
controles.livre: Será comido o dia que o sacrificardes, e o dia seguinte: e o que restar para o terceiro dia, será queimado no fogo.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֛ם הֵאָכֹ֥ל יֵאָכֵ֖ל בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י פִּגּ֥וּל ה֖וּא לֹ֥א יֵרָצֶֽה׃

controles.web: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It will not be accepted;
controles.kjv: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.
controles.livre: E se se comer no dia terceiro, será abominação; não será aceito:

versos.hebraico: וְאֹֽכְלָיו֙ עֲוֺנ֣וֹ יִשָּׂ֔א כִּֽי־אֶת־קֹ֥דֶשׁ יְהוָ֖ה חִלֵּ֑ל וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּֽיהָ׃

controles.web: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of Yahweh, and that soul shall be cut off from his people.
controles.kjv: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the Lord: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
controles.livre: E o que o comer, levará seu delito, porquanto profanou o santo do SENHOR; e a tal pessoa será eliminada de seus povos.

versos.hebraico: וּֽבְקֻצְרְכֶם֙ אֶת־קְצִ֣יר אַרְצְכֶ֔ם לֹ֧א תְכַלֶּ֛ה פְּאַ֥ת שָׂדְךָ֖ לִקְצֹ֑ר וְלֶ֥קֶט קְצִֽירְךָ֖ לֹ֥א תְלַקֵּֽט׃

controles.web: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.
controles.kjv: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
controles.livre: Quando ceifardes na colheita de vossa terra, não acabarás de ceifar o canto de tua plantação, nem espigarás tua terra ceifada.

versos.hebraico: וְכַרְמְךָ֙ לֹ֣א תְעוֹלֵ֔ל וּפֶ֥רֶט כַּרְמְךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְלַקֵּ֑ט לֶֽעָנִ֤י וְלַגֵּר֙ תַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֹתָ֔ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard; you shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the Lord your God.
controles.livre: E não coletarás os restos de tua vinha, nem recolherás as uvas caídas de tua vinha; para o pobre e para o estrangeiro os deixarás: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: לֹ֖א תִּגְנֹ֑בוּ וְלֹא־תְכַחֲשׁ֥וּ וְלֹֽא־תְשַׁקְּר֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ בַּעֲמִיתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “‘You shall not steal.   “‘You shall not lie.   “‘You shall not deceive one another.
controles.kjv: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
controles.livre: Não furtareis, e não enganareis, nem mentireis ninguém a seu próximo.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹֽא־תִשָּׁבְע֥וּ בִשְׁמִ֖י לַשָּׁ֑קֶר וְחִלַּלְתָּ֛ אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: E não jurareis em meu nome com mentira, nem profanarás o nome de teu Deus: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־תַעֲשֹׁ֥ק אֶת־רֵֽעֲךָ֖ וְלֹ֣א תִגְזֹ֑ל לֹֽא־תָלִ֞ין פְּעֻלַּ֥ת שָׂכִ֛יר אִתְּךָ֖ עַד־בֹּֽקֶר׃

controles.web: “‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him.   “‘The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all night until the morning.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
controles.livre: Não oprimirás a teu próximo, nem lhe roubarás. Não se deterá o trabalho do assalariado em tua casa até a manhã.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־תְקַלֵּ֣ל חֵרֵ֔שׁ וְלִפְנֵ֣י עִוֵּ֔ר לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן מִכְשֹׁ֑ל וְיָרֵ֥אתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Não amaldiçoes ao surdo, e diante do cego não ponhas tropeço, mas terás temor de teu Deus: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־תַעֲשׂ֥וּ עָ֨וֶל֙ בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֔ט לֹא־תִשָּׂ֣א פְנֵי־דָ֔ל וְלֹ֥א תֶהְדַּ֖ר פְּנֵ֣י גָד֑וֹל בְּצֶ֖דֶק תִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט עֲמִיתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: “‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.
controles.kjv: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.
controles.livre: Não farás injustiça no juízo: não favorecerás deslealmente ao pobre, nem honrarás a face do poderoso: com justiça julgarás a teu próximo.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־תֵלֵ֤ךְ רָכִיל֙ בְּעַמֶּ֔יךָ לֹ֥א תַעֲמֹ֖ד עַל־דַּ֣ם רֵעֶ֑ךָ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘You shall not go up and down as a slanderer among your people.   “‘You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Não andarás propagando boatos em teus povos. Não te porás contra o sangue de teu próximo: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־תִשְׂנָ֥א אֶת־אָחִ֖יךָ בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ הוֹכֵ֤חַ תּוֹכִ֨יחַ֙ אֶת־עֲמִיתֶ֔ךָ וְלֹא־תִשָּׂ֥א עָלָ֖יו חֵֽטְא׃

controles.web: “‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.
controles.livre: Não aborrecerás a teu irmão em teu coração: francamente repreenderás a teu próximo, e não consentirás sobre ele pecado.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־תִקֹּ֤ם וְלֹֽא־תִטֹּר֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֔ךָ וְאָֽהַבְתָּ֥ לְרֵעֲךָ֖ כָּמ֑וֹךָ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Não te vingarás, nem guardarás rancor aos filhos de teu povo: mas amarás a teu próximo como a ti mesmo: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: אֶֽת־חֻקֹּתַי֮ תִּשְׁמֹרוּ֒ בְּהֶמְתְּךָ֙ לֹא־תַרְבִּ֣יעַ כִּלְאַ֔יִם שָׂדְךָ֖ לֹא־תִזְרַ֣ע כִּלְאָ֑יִם וּבֶ֤גֶד כִּלְאַ֨יִם֙ שַֽׁעַטְנֵ֔ז לֹ֥א יַעֲלֶ֖ה עָלֶֽיךָ׃פ

controles.web: “‘You shall keep my statutes.   “‘You shall not cross-breed different kinds of animals.   “‘You shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed;   “‘neither shall there come upon you a garment made of two kinds of material.
controles.kjv: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.
controles.livre: Meus estatutos guardareis. A teu animal não farás ajuntar para espécies misturadas; tua plantação não semearás com mistura de sementes, e não te porás roupas com mistura de diversos materiais.

versos.hebraico: וְ֠אִישׁ כִּֽי־יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אֶת־אִשָּׁ֜ה שִׁכְבַת־זֶ֗רַע וְהִ֤וא שִׁפְחָה֙ נֶחֱרֶ֣פֶת לְאִ֔ישׁ וְהָפְדֵּה֙ לֹ֣א נִפְדָּ֔תָה א֥וֹ חֻפְשָׁ֖ה לֹ֣א נִתַּן־לָ֑הּ בִּקֹּ֧רֶת תִּהְיֶ֛ה לֹ֥א יוּמְת֖וּ כִּי־לֹ֥א חֻפָּֽשָׁה׃

controles.web: “‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed, or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
controles.kjv: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
controles.livre: E quando um homem tiver relação sexual com mulher, e ela for serva desposada com alguém, e não estiver resgatada, nem lhe houver sido dada liberdade, ambos serão açoitados: não morrerão, porquanto ela não é livre.

versos.hebraico: וְהֵבִ֤יא אֶת־אֲשָׁמוֹ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד אֵ֖יל אָשָֽׁם׃

controles.web: He shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, even a ram for a trespass offering.
controles.kjv: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the Lord, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.
controles.livre: E ele trará ao SENHOR, à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho, um carneiro em expiação por sua culpa.

versos.hebraico: וְכִפֶּר֩ עָלָ֨יו הַכֹּהֵ֜ן בְּאֵ֤יל הָֽאָשָׁם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עַל־חַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֑א וְנִסְלַ֣ח ל֔וֹ מֵחַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽא׃פ

controles.web: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before Yahweh for his sin which he has committed: and the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.
controles.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the Lord for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.
controles.livre: E com o carneiro da expiação o reconciliará o sacerdote diante do SENHOR, por seu pecado que cometeu: e se lhe perdoará seu pecado que cometeu.

versos.hebraico: וְכִי־תָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־הָאָ֗רֶץ וּנְטַעְתֶּם֙ כָּל־עֵ֣ץ מַאֲכָ֔ל וַעֲרַלְתֶּ֥ם עָרְלָת֖וֹ אֶת־פִּרְי֑וֹ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֗ים יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם עֲרֵלִ֖ים לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵֽל׃

controles.web: “‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden. Three years shall they be forbidden to you. It shall not be eaten.
controles.kjv: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.
controles.livre: E quando houverdes entrado na terra, e plantardes toda árvore de comer, tirareis seu prepúcio, o primeiro de seu fruto: três anos vos será incircunciso: seu fruto não se comerá.

versos.hebraico: וּבַשָּׁנָה֙ הָרְבִיעִ֔ת יִהְיֶ֖ה כָּל־פִּרְי֑וֹ קֹ֥דֶשׁ הִלּוּלִ֖ים לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the Lord withal.
controles.livre: E o quarto ano todo seu fruto será santidade de louvores ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וּבַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַחֲמִישִׁ֗ת תֹּֽאכְלוּ֙ אֶת־פִּרְי֔וֹ לְהוֹסִ֥יף לָכֶ֖ם תְּבוּאָת֑וֹ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am Yahweh your God.
controles.kjv: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am the Lord your God.
controles.livre: Mas ao quinto ano comereis o fruto dele, para que vos faça crescer seu fruto: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: לֹ֥א תֹאכְל֖וּ עַל־הַדָּ֑ם לֹ֥א תְנַחֲשׁ֖וּ וְלֹ֥א תְעוֹנֵֽנוּ׃

controles.web: “‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it; neither shall you use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.
controles.kjv: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.
controles.livre: Não comereis coisa alguma com sangue. Não sereis encantadores, nem fareis adivinhações.

versos.hebraico: לֹ֣א תַקִּ֔פוּ פְּאַ֖ת רֹאשְׁכֶ֑ם וְלֹ֣א תַשְׁחִ֔ית אֵ֖ת פְּאַ֥ת זְקָנֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: “‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your heads, neither shall you clip off the edge of your beard.
controles.kjv: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
controles.livre: Não cortareis em redondo as extremidades de vossas cabeças, nem danificarás a ponta de tua barba.

versos.hebraico: וְשֶׂ֣רֶט לָנֶ֗פֶשׁ לֹ֤א תִתְּנוּ֙ בִּבְשַׂרְכֶ֔ם וּכְתֹ֣בֶת קַֽעֲקַ֔ע לֹ֥א תִתְּנ֖וּ בָּכֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: E não fareis cortes em vossa carne por um morto, nem imprimireis em vós sinal alguma: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תְּחַלֵּ֥ל אֶֽת־בִּתְּךָ֖ לְהַזְנוֹתָ֑הּ וְלֹא־תִזְנֶ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ וּמָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ זִמָּֽה׃

controles.web: “‘Don’t profane your daughter, to make her a prostitute; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness.
controles.kjv: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
controles.livre: Não contaminarás tua filha fazendo-a se prostituir: para não se prostitua a terra, e se encha de maldade.

versos.hebraico: אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַ֣י תִּשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י תִּירָ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Meus sábados guardareis, e meu santuário tereis em reverência: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּפְנ֤וּ אֶל־הָאֹבֹת֙ וְאֶל־הַיִּדְּעֹנִ֔ים אַל־תְּבַקְשׁ֖וּ לְטָמְאָ֣ה בָהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am Yahweh your God.
controles.kjv: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the Lord your God.
controles.livre: Não vos volteis aos encantadores e aos adivinhos: não os consulteis contaminando-vos com eles: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: מִפְּנֵ֤י שֵׂיבָה֙ תָּק֔וּם וְהָדַרְתָּ֖ פְּנֵ֣י זָקֵ֑ן וְיָרֵ֥אתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: “‘You shall rise up before the gray head, and honor the face of an old man, and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Diante das cãs te levantarás, e honrarás o rosto do ancião, e de teu Deus terás temor: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יָג֧וּר אִתְּךָ֛ גֵּ֖ר בְּאַרְצְכֶ֑ם לֹ֥א תוֹנ֖וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.
controles.kjv: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.
controles.livre: E quando o estrangeiro morar contigo em vossa terra, não o oprimireis.

versos.hebraico: כְּאֶזְרָ֣ח מִכֶּם֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם הַגֵּ֣ר׀ הַגָּ֣ר אִתְּכֶ֗ם וְאָהַבְתָּ֥ לוֹ֙ כָּמ֔וֹךָ כִּֽי־גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.
controles.kjv: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.
controles.livre: Como a um natural de vós tereis ao estrangeiro que peregrinar entre vós; e ama-o como a ti mesmo; porque peregrinos fostes na terra do Egito: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־תַעֲשׂ֥וּ עָ֖וֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט בַּמִּדָּ֕ה בַּמִּשְׁקָ֖ל וּבַמְּשׂוּרָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.
controles.kjv: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
controles.livre: Não façais injustiça no juízo, na medida da terra, nem no peso, nem em outra medida.

versos.hebraico: מֹ֧אזְנֵי צֶ֣דֶק אַבְנֵי־צֶ֗דֶק אֵ֥יפַת צֶ֛דֶק וְהִ֥ין צֶ֖דֶק יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם אֲנִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
controles.kjv: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the Lord your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
controles.livre: Balanças justas, pesos justos, efa justo, e him justo tereis. Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, que vos tirei da terra do Egito.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֶת־כָּל־חֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־מִשְׁפָּטַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: “‘You shall observe all my statutes, and all my ordinances, and do them. I am Yahweh.’”
controles.kjv: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Guardai, pois, todos os meus estatutos, e todos os meus regulamentos, e os praticai. Eu sou o SENHOR.
